transcript.text: Good morning. Before I sign off on the annex room assignments and controls, I need facilities and signal to report any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements. We have two rooms available — East and West — both ready tomorrow morning. We'll be placing an equipment-issue desk and a protected medical-records desk in there. What do I need to know from each of you before I approve?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, facilities has a critical floor-load concern. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified this morning that East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. The equipment-issue desk needs to go in West Room — East Room cannot safely support that weight. I should note the floor-load figures haven't been added to the relocation worksheet yet, but the measurements are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, signal has a critical room-assignment constraint. The protected medical-records desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection from 0900 to 1000 tomorrow — I received the booking confirmation this morning. However, that certification task is not yet on the annex opening checklist, so it needs to be added. This means the medical-records desk needs to go in East Room, which also needs to be ready and accessible for the technician tomorrow morning.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Add confirmed floor-load ratings (East: 800 kg, West: 1,500 kg) to the relocation worksheet.
Add the 0900-1000 fiber patch panel certification task to the annex opening checklist.
Ensure East Room is ready and accessible for the signal technician by 0900 tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: A1

commitments.detail: Add confirmed floor-load ratings (East: 800 kg, West: 1,500 kg) to the relocation worksheet.
